components.title: RideTube service
components.description: The car side of RideTube, an unofficial client for YouTube: yt-dlp (from its official release, run in mgu-python) fetches as the daemon's own internet uid; search, feeds and thumbnails on the car (jap-node22); audio through the BMW MediaPlayer, video decoded by ytdec into the mgu-render video layer; TV device sign-in; controlled by the RideTube app over /run/jap-ridetube-d/ctl.sock

components.title: YouT
components.description: Video in the car: an unofficial client for YouTube. Your Home, Subscriptions, Watch later, History and playlists (signed in on the car), search, channels and chapters; the sound through the car's media player, the picture only while parked (a podcast view while driving). Needs the jap-ridetube-d tool.

components.title: Full-width touch
components.description: Lets full-screen apps (RideTube, Moonride) use the screen's left edge: both renderers get the whole screen as their touch area, so a tap on the strip where the back arrow usually is reaches the app instead of closing it. Leave such an app with the BACK or MENU button. Other apps keep the back arrow. Removing it takes effect at the next start of the head unit.
